# Google Play listing: Forest Locator

The text and answers entered in Play Console for the Android app. Paste from here; when the
listing changes in Play, change it here too, so this file says what Play shows.
Name rules: DECISIONS 2026-11-04 (the name) and 2026-08-15 (no "Forestry England" in the title).

## Store listing

**App name** (30 max): Forest Locator

**Short description** (80 max):
Nearest forests, car parks and campsites in Great Britain. Works with no signal.

**Full description:**

Forest Locator lists forests, forest car parks and campsites across England, Scotland and Wales,
nearest first. Tap one and it opens in Google Maps or Waze to take you there.

Made for the car and for places with no signal:
- Works fully offline once opened. All sites are stored on your phone.
- Large text and a dark screen, easy to read at night.
- Filter by name, or switch between forests, car parks and campsites.
- A map view with a built-in outline of Great Britain that needs no signal.

Your location stays on your phone. No account, no adverts, no tracking.

Covers forests managed by Forestry England, Forestry and Land Scotland and Natural Resources
Wales, official forest car parks in England, and campsites from OpenStreetMap.

Forest details: Crown Copyright, courtesy Forestry England, licensed under the Open Government
Licence. Forestry and Land Scotland and Natural Resources Wales information licensed under the
Open Government Licence v3.0. Campsite data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
This app is not affiliated with Forestry England, Forestry and Land Scotland or Natural Resources
Wales.

**Category:** Maps & Navigation
**Contact email:** r@enhanceify.co.uk
**Website:** https://forestlocator.enhanceify.co.uk/
**Privacy policy:** https://forestlocator.enhanceify.co.uk/privacy.html (`app/privacy.html`)

## App content answers

- **Ads:** no ads.
- **App access:** all functions available without special access (no login).
- **Target audience:** 18 and over. The app is not designed for children.
- **Data safety:** no data collected and no data shared. Location is used on the device only and
  never sent (Play counts data as "collected" only when it leaves the device). Encrypted in
  transit: yes (HTTPS). No account, so no deletion request route is needed.
- **Content rating:** reference/utility app, no violence, no user content, no purchases, shares
  location with nobody.
- **Government app:** no. **Financial features:** none. **Health:** none. **News:** no.
